_comment: УТ-2 (@yt-2). Every colour here was measured off their own footage rather than chosen: the accent is the studio's purple wall behind the left-hand host, sampled from 164k saturated pixels of a close-up (mean #44276D, 85th percentile #4F2D7F -- the lit part of the wall, which is what a viewer reads as the colour). The ink is the near-black of their set. Swap this file for another brand and the same template draws another channel's card.
